NONE: › a set of beliefs, especially ones that you disapprove of
（尤指自己不贊成的）主義，學說
› used to form nouns that refer to social, political, or religious beliefs, studies, or ways of behaving
（構成名詞）主義，信仰，研究，行為方式

example: Thatcher is unique among her predecessors in having given the English language a brand new ism, created from her own name.
柴契爾為英語詞彙增添了一個全新的「主義」，以其本人姓氏命名，這與前任各屆首相相比是獨一無二的。
That expression was a real Taylor-ism (= an example of behaving or speaking like Taylor).
那種表達具有典型的泰勒特徵。
